description: This Java class, ImageFilePathUtils, provides utility methods to construct file paths for images related to products, manufacturers, and store logos within the Shopizer e-commerce platform. It builds URLs based on store data, content types, and image identifiers to facilitate access to static images.

classes.name: ImageFilePathUtils
classes.description: Utility class for constructing image file paths for static content, products, manufacturers, store logos, and product properties within the Shopizer platform.

methods.name: buildStaticImageFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for static images used by the image servlet, based on store and image name.

methods.name: buildManufacturerImageFilePath
methods.description: Builds a file path for manufacturer images, incorporating store, manufacturer ID, and image name.

methods.name: buildProductImageFilePath (with Product parameter)
methods.description: Creates a path pointing to a product image based on store, product SKU, and image name.

methods.name: buildProductImageFilePath (with sku parameter)
methods.description: Creates a path for a product image using store, SKU, and image name.

methods.name: buildLargeProductImageFilePath
methods.description: Builds a file path for large-sized product images.

methods.name: buildStoreLogoFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the URL path for the store's logo image.

methods.name: buildProductPropertyImageFilePath
methods.description: Creates a file path for product property images based on store and image name.
